comments:
DryLife is an outer-totalistic Life-like cellular automaton
with rulestring B37/S23. It behaves explosively in nature, see for
example evolution of the stairstep hexomino.

In this rule, copies of R-pentomino can be combined to make
spaceships, puffers and rakes travelling at 9c/28 orthogonal, akin
to the switch engines in Life. There is also a small period-32
reflectorless rotating oscillator called spinner.

The following pattern is a period-480 gun for a 5-engine 9c/28o

In February 2015, Ivan Fomichev discovered a new spaceship
in the well-known rule HighLife. It has bilateral symmetry, 24
cells in the mimimum phase, travelling at a speed of c/98
orthogonal. Soon Martin Grant found a 10-glider synthesis for it.

In June 2016, Luka Okanishi constructed this period-1728 gun
using a 16-glider synthesis. 1728 (=12^3) ticks is the minimum
compression possible for a stream of these sparky, non-monotonic
c/98o spaceships without interaction, which curiously happens to be
compatible with the replicator-based devices whose base period is

name: 行人生命：斜向耙枪
note: 规则 B38/S23。

#N pedestrian-life-oblique-rake-gun.rle
#O Luka Okanishi, 3 May 2016
#C
#C In the realm of outer-totalistic Life-like cellular automata,
#C the highest birth condition is B8. Adding that to the Game of Life
#C gives Pedestrian Life, B38/S23, so named because the traffic light
#C constellation is much less common. A large number of Life patterns
#C just work as well in this rule - but there are something especially
#C not pedestrian! For one, the classical methuselah R-pentomino shows
#C different behaviour that allows for them to be combined akin to
#C the switch engine in Life. The result is a class of spaceships, 
#C puffers and rakes travelling obliquely at a speed of (5,2)c/190.
#C
#C The following pattern is a bootstrapping period-1326 gun for 
#C one of those rakes based on an 8-glider synthesis. After a rake is
#C built, some of its output gliders are directed by series of Snarks
#C and p6 bumpers so as to produce the next rake. In other words, it
#C is essentially engine-less!
#C
#C Reference:
#C https://conwaylife.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=1661&p=30569#p30569
#C
#C For general description on this rule, see LifeWiki article:
#C https://conwaylife.com/wiki/OCA:Pedestrian_Life

In the realm of outer-totalistic Life-like cellular automata,
the highest birth condition is B8. Adding that to the Game of Life
gives Pedestrian Life, B38/S23, so named because the traffic light
constellation is much less common. A large number of Life patterns
just work as well in this rule - but there are something especially
not pedestrian! For one, the classical methuselah R-pentomino shows
different behaviour that allows for them to be combined akin to
the switch engine in Life. The result is a class of spaceships,
puffers and rakes travelling obliquely at a speed of (5,2)c/190.

name: 十六进制计数器
note: 在生命游戏里搭出的两位十六进制计数器。
comments:
Two-digit hexadecimal counter in Conway's Life.  Distant relative
of Alan Hensel's Decimal Counter (see Guns/golly-ticker.rle),
and a close relative of the 'META' patterns in Hashing-Examples:
the tiles have the same base period, 35328 ticks, and share the
same large-scale pixel machinery, with an adapted clock mechanism.
The first pixel updates begin just before generation 6000.

The tiles can easily be programmed to count from 00 to FF by ones,
but the novelty wears off quickly!  The original version started
out counting by ones; this version counts by &H10 up to &HD0 first.
Brice Due, 9 March 2007; movie reduced to 128 bits by Dave Greene.

name: 元像素：星系
note: OTCA 元像素：每个“像素”本身都是一台 2048×2048 的生命游戏机器，合起来模拟一个科克星系。缩小看，生命游戏在模拟它自己。
comments:
this is an OTCAmetapixel tiling which requires Golly.
get Golly at http://golly.sourceforge.net

OTCAmetapixel unit cell by Brice Due (fall 2005 - spring 2006).

USAGE: Speed steps 8^3 - 8^6 are good. Be patient after changing the speed
step; the hashlife cache needs time to warm up. Try increasing the maximum
hash memory setting if the meta-pattern continues to run haltingly.

name: 断线
note: 它能一直运行下去吗？Dean Hickerson，2005。
comments:
Broken lines pattern - does it work forever?
Dean Hickerson, 7 May 2005

A p48 gun sends LWSSs eastward, while an eastward p24 puffer sends LWSSs
westward, and a northward p24 rake sends gliders southeastward.  When LWSSs
collide, they send gliders northeast and southwest.  The southwest ones
escape, forming the longest broken line.  A northeast glider may crash into
one from the rake, in a kickback reaction that sends a glider southwest.
The surviving southeast gliders delete westward LWSSs.

Sometimes a kicked-back glider hits another northeast glider, forming a
block.  Sometimes a block will be deleted by yet another northeast glider.

name: Roth 生成器
note: 闪光灯排成的四条线，记录着某种数列。
comments:
Roth generator

Four puffers produce gliders, whose collisions produce four
lines of blinkers representing a transcendental number
meeting Roth's transcendence criterion:
.110110111110110111110110110..., where the n'th bit is 1 if n
is not divisible by 3 and is the complement of the (n/3)'th bit
if n is divisible by 3.  See https://www.jjj.de/fxt/fxtbook.pdf, 38.2
Built by Bill Gosper, before 1974?
From Alan Hensel's 'bclife' collection.

name: 尺子
note: 一组组飞船像尺子上的刻度。
comments:
This produces groups of LWSSs headed west, with gaps of fixed size
between them.  The lengths of the groups form the 'ruler' sequence,
1 2 1 3 1 2 1 4 1 2 1 3 1 2 1 5 ... (Sloane's A001511).  The first
group of length n is emitted about generation 96*2^n. The pattern
uses a Corderman eater puffer found by Paul Tooke (Jan 2004), a
p48 glider gun by Noam Elkies (Jun 1997), a p8 glider reflector by
Noam Elkies (Sep 1998), and a p24 LWSS puffer (source unknown).
Dean Hickerson, 4/20/2005

name: 线性传播者
note: 在生命游戏里真正自我复制的图样，周期 237228340。
comments:
This pattern is a phase-shifted linear replicator in Conway's Game of Life.
Of the three initial versions, this one can run in Golly most efficiently,
due to the smaller number of hashtiles.  Half-size and quarter-size versions
can be found in Golly's Online Archives, or at

http://conwaylife.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=2&t=1006&p=9925#p9901

The replicator returns to its original state after 237,228,340 ticks,
and produces an exact copy of itself after 237,228,617 ticks.  The parent
pattern is blocked from making further copies by the presence of its child,
which takes over the replication process and produces a grandchild pattern.

name: 超慢 loafer 枪
note: 每 2^23 代才射出一艘飞船。
comments:
This is a very slow gun shooting c/7 loafer spaceships every 2^23 ticks.
Zoom in on the upper left corner to see the loafers being constructed.
This non-standard gun builds a "loafer seed" made out of blocks, using
a very long salvo, and then triggering the seed with a final glider.
In this version, the loafer seed is triggered starting around T=2000;
the next eight million generations are spent rebuilding the seed.

See Patterns/Life/Guns/loafer-gun-p210.rle for a much faster loafer gun.
The only possible advantage of this gun is that it can very easily be
altered to produce new variants -- a tethered loafer rake, for example,
where each new loafer travels on a different lane.

Single-channel construction arms continuously extending three wicks
using three copies of a 0-degree Snark recipe in the form of a
single glider stream stored in a double spiral.

Dave Greene, 21 June 2017, based on research and search utilities
by Simon Ekstrom and Adam P. Goucher.  Period is 262144 ticks.

If Golly has enough memory available, this pattern will run faster
at 8^4 or 8^5 after finishing its first construction cycle,
because many of the hashtiles will be re-used on future cycles.
